acceptance_gates: Command bounding: 100% of issued actuator commands shall remain within configured min/max limits during validation runs.
Stale-data rejection: 100% of intentionally stale commands injected during test shall be rejected.
Timeout handling: 100% of simulated timeout events shall cause the controller to enter the defined fallback state.
Safe fallback: 100% of fallback transitions shall produce a documented safe actuator command or hold state.
Reference availability: A transparent reference path shall produce outputs for 100% of validation cases within the operating envelope.
Operating-envelope coverage: Validation shall include test cases spanning the full 20-55 m/s range.
Freshness enforcement: All accepted commands shall pass freshness checks with measured age below the configured freshness threshold.
Geometry handling: STL input shall be parsed successfully for all conformance test geometries in the approved dataset.
Interface integrity: All declared interfaces shall exchange data without schema or protocol errors in integration testing.
Traceability: Every control decision in validation shall be traceable to inputs, reference outputs, and safety-state outcomes.
constraints: Operating scope limited to the stated stream-velocity envelope.
Geometry input shall be accepted in STL format.
Reference geometry source shall be compatible with DrivAerML reference geometry.
Control outputs shall be bounded to prevent actuator overdrive.
Stale model commands shall be rejected.
Command timeout conditions shall trigger defined fallback behavior.
Safe fallback shall remain available independent of model output validity.
Any surrogate or controller evaluation shall be benchmarked against a transparent reference path.
No board, processor, or implementation fabric is implied by this contract.
No pretrained inference result is assumed.
No model accuracy is fabricated beyond measurable acceptance criteria.
All performance claims must be validated on the declared operating envelope.

name: intelligent_active_aerodynamics_controller
objective: Develop an intelligent active-aerodynamics control product for automotive use over 20-55 m/s flow conditions. The product shall support evaluation of a physics-based surrogate, a transparent reference implementation, system partitioning, architecture definition and optimization, and delivery of hardware, firmware, and software capabilities that enforce bounded control, stale-data detection, timeout handling, and safe fallback behavior.
required_capabilities: Accept vehicle/aerodynamic geometry inputs in STL form.
Ingest stream-velocity conditions within the declared operating envelope.
Provide a transparent reference computation path for comparison and validation.
Evaluate a physics-based surrogate against the reference path.
Partition the application into sensing, estimation, decision, actuation, and safety functions.
Detect stale command or stale-state conditions using explicit freshness checks.
Detect timeout conditions on model, control, or communication paths.
Reject commands that violate freshness, validity, or bounds constraints.
Transition to a safe fallback mode when command validity cannot be guaranteed.
Expose status and fault information suitable for integration into a higher-level vehicle control stack.
Support architecture definition and optimization activities without binding to a specific compute target.
Support delivery of hardware, firmware, and software implementations as separate deliverables if needed.
